title: pvImageDatatoPointSet
body:
## pvImageDatatoPointSet

Converts uniform image data (vtkImageData) into an equivalent structured grid with explicit point coordinates; point and cell arrays are kept. Use it before operations that move or need explicit points but reject image data, at the cost of storing coordinates.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Output memory grows by three coordinates per point; avoid it on large volumes unless needed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ImageDatatoPointSet`. Identity: `filters/ImageDataToPointSet`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
